# The barrel fills after the path floods

The downpipe barrel is full, yet water stands beside the shed. Capturing rain is not the same as moving it away from the path. Sketched the slope with a borrowed level. The low spot belongs to the neighbour, so a neat engineering drawing does not give me permission to redirect water there. [[Garden notebook]] and [[Field methods]] now share a sketch, not a conclusion.
